column1: # Readings of the Khemraj print (Śrī Veṅkaṭeśvara Steam Press, Bombay, 1902; archive.org
# scans) adopted over the Wikisource e-text, from a verse-by-verse collation.
# Spelling conventions are not collated (anusvāra for a class nasal, ddh/dh doubling,
# avagraha). One line per change, tab-separated:
#   part  adhyāya  verse  op  e-text  print  [scan leaf]
# op r = replace the e-text words with the print's; split = a new verse begins at the
# given words (the e-text fused two); head = drop a heading line set into the verse;
# drop = remove a contributor's note set as a line of the verse.
